universal_viewer.setting.lock_mode.toolt: How the lock key (Ctrl by default, rebindable in Controls) locks a shulker box or bundle preview in place: while it is held, or from one press to the next.
universal_viewer.setting.tooltip_map_siz: Size of the map picture in a map's tooltip. The frame scales with it.
universal_viewer.setting.slot_marks.tool: What a shulker box or bundle shows on its slot: a bar for how full it is (shulker boxes; bundles have their own) and a small icon of the item it holds the most of.
universal_viewer.setting.search_box.tool: A field above container screens that finds items by name, also inside shulker boxes, bundles and the remembered ender chest: matches are outlined and the rest dimmed.
